text:
infra-bot: ALERT: edge-proxy-eu-west large fanout detected. 5xx/429 spike from 34 IPs, traffic amplification x12. Auto-mitigation candidate suggested. (alert id: A-2026-5990)
olivia: paging oncall — looks like embeddings fanout hitting edge proxies in eu-west, paging @alex-oncall
alex-oncall: on it. grabbing logs, putting pager into incident state. can someone attach the short query sample?
infra-bot: sample requests (top 3): 
```
POST /v1/embeddings batch_size=128 client=unknown UA=okhttp/4.9.3
Bearer token: <redacted>
paths: [/v1/embeddings] qps: 420 -> 5xx: 18%\n```
sre-lead: Those IPs look like proxy chains (same ASN). probable scrape farm. priority: protect capacity + minimize customer impact.
alex-oncall: quick plan: 1) enable proxy circuit-breaker on edge for connections > 50 fanout 2) tighten per-token rate limit for anonymous tokens 3) temp disable batch embeddings endpoint for non-authenticated tenants 4) WAF block on UA patterns. executing step 1 now.
alex-oncall: ran command: 
```
infractl edge circuit-break enable --region eu-west --threshold 50 --drop-mode backpressure
```
infra-bot: circuit-breaker engaged on 3 edge nodes. immediate drop in queue depth on those nodes.
olivia: nice, any customer impact seen yet? CX on standby @sam-cx
sam-cx: Monitoring — a few customers (3) reported higher tail latency on embeddings, no errors yet. flagged for status page if errors appear.
alex-oncall: stepping 2: apply adaptive per-token quota for anonymous clients: 
```
ratectl update --scope anonymous --region eu-west --tokens-per-minute 2000 --burst 4000
```
infra-bot: new quota applied. observed 30% reduction in request rate from offending IPs.
product-eng: what's the rollback plan if we hit false positives?
sre-lead: rollback: run infractl edge circuit-break disable {node-list}; ratectl restore --snapshot pre-5990011222; re-enable batch endpoint. keep canary for 5m.
alex-oncall: step 3: disabling batch embeddings for unauthenticated routes. command: 
```
feature-flag set embeddings.batch.allow_anonymous false --region eu-west
```
infra-bot: feature toggle confirmed. anonymous batch requests now return 403.
sam-cx: CX update: sent proactive note to affected accounts in eu-west trial tier. awaiting replies.
olivia: WAF rule to block suspicious UA strings (okhttp + java-requests combos) — roll it with conservative action (tarpit 10s) first.
alex-oncall: pushed WAF rule in monitor->tarpit: 
```
wafctl rule add --name "suspicious-ua-proxychain" --ua-regex "(okhttp|python-requests).*(gzip)" --action tarpit --tarpit-seconds 10
```
infra-bot: WAF rule active. initial log sample shows 70% of offending requests matched.
alex-oncall: metrics: 5xx rate down from 18% -> 6% in 6m; overall edge CPU down 22%.
sre-lead: good. next: keep circuit-breaker in place, leave rate limits for now, keep batch anonymous disabled for 30m, then reassess.
product-eng: are internal customers (partners) impacted by batch toggle? any SSO or enterprise keys blocked?
alex-oncall: only anonymous/unauth slices affected; enterprise keys unaffected. double-checking allowlist: 
```
ratectl show --allowlist
-> partners@example.com, enterprise-123
```
sam-cx: update to customers: sent another note clarifying enterprise unaffected. one reply asking for ETA to restore.
olivia: set status page to partial degradation for embeddings in EU-West. small message: "We are mitigating a spike from abusive traffic affecting embeddings in EU-West; some batch requests for anonymous clients blocked. No data loss."
product-eng: ok to publish?
sam-cx: go ahead. posted. status id: ST-5990-embed-eu
alex-oncall: starting 15m monitoring window. If error rates remain <8% we'll widen circuit-break threshold to 100 and re-enable anonymous batch for selected canary IPs.
infra-bot: 5m checkpoint: 5xx down to 4.8%, overall QPS down 38% from peak. offending IP set shrank by 60%.
sre-lead: recommend follow-up runbook entry for proxy-circuit behaviour and refine UA regex to avoid blocking legitimate SDK clients. add test harness for tarpit impact.
product-eng: file a follow-up ticket for SDK owners to check UA formatting. assign to @product-eng.
alex-oncall: raising postmortem flag—will mark as mitigation-only (no customer data exposure). will handoff to next oncall at 5990011800.
olivia: handoff noted. @alex-oncall please post final snapshot before handoff.
alex-oncall: final snapshot: 
```
time window: 20m
5xx: 18% -> 4.2%
QPS: peak 420 -> 120
blocked requests (waf+tarpit): ~24k
customers reporting latency: 2 (informational)
```
infra-bot: Handoff: incident state -> needs-triage. next oncall: @sre-lead.
sre-lead: taking over. will keep circuit-breaker active and schedule 1hr follow-up. please attach logs and rule IDs in the incident ticket.
sam-cx: CX: will follow up with the 2 customers with timeline and mitigation steps; offering workaround: use authenticated single-item embeddings for now.
olivia: thanks team. good mitigation, minimal customer impact. closing chat. :thumbsup:
